Character reference: @image1 and @image2 are the same man: a 29-year-old Korean man: soft oval face with a gentle rounded jaw, small bright single-lidded eyes that crease kindly when he smiles, thick straight dark eyebrows, neat short two-block haircut with a natural side-swept fringe, clean-shaven with clear healthy skin, black square acetate glasses, a small dimple on the left cheek, slightly prominent ears. Outfit: navy crew-neck knit sweater with a white t-shirt collar showing, beige straight chino trousers, white leather sneakers. Not a model, not an idol; natural, slightly asymmetric face, real skin texture. Framing reference: recreate the framing of @image3 exactly: tight close-up, eye level, 70mm look, bright cafe with mint-green wall, window and plants softly out of focus behind him; he holds a white smartphone low in the frame, screen toward his face.
One continuous shot. A friend at the next table films on a smartphone held vertically; very light handheld breathing of 1 to 2 cm, no zoom, no pan. Modern phone video, clean natural colors, no over-sharpening, no film grain.
0.0s to 0.5s: he looks at the phone, expression flat. 0.5s to 2.3s: he lifts his eyes from the phone toward the woman beside him, off screen to the left (never toward the camera), and asks the single short word, eyebrows up, startled; his head barely moves. 2.3s to 3.0s: he holds the look toward her, mouth slightly open.
His face must match @image1 and @image2 exactly through the whole take; hair stays neat, nothing sticking up. Eyes steady, natural blinks only, no look at the camera. Only one phone in frame. No subtitles, no on-screen text. Absolutely no music.
The man says in Korean, startled, as a short question: "어머님?" Natural delivery, visible lip-sync.
